summary: Agree Realty Corp filed a routine 424B5 prospectus supplement on September 17, 2026, registering common stock under an existing shelf registration statement (file no. 333-295307). The filing represents an ordinary capital-markets takedown by the REIT and its operating partnership entities, not a special situation. No price per share, share count, stake percentage, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or deal terms are stated. Mechanics involve standard shelf takedown capacity and potential share overhang. What to watch: actual pricing and use of proceeds, which will clarify whether the raise funds acquisitions or general corporate purposes.
